name: Whirl imp
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes, one of the Magma King's: leathery skin, short curled horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, pink-hot skin, always half-turned as if spinning

poses.stand: hovering mid-air on spread bat wings, mid-twirl, arms stretched out to the sides, two thin trails of pink-hot embers curling off its fingertips
poses.struck: just hit and caught mid-shriek: eyes bulging, mouth stretched open, wings snapped up, body tilted back with cracks of orange light glowing through its skin
poses.dead: bursting apart in a small round pop of black soot and bright orange embers, only its horns tumbling out of the puff

idle.action: hovers and slowly twirls on the spot, flapping, pink-hot embers curling off its fingertips

attack.action: spins fast and two spirals of pink embers wind out from its hands, then slows to a hover

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a yelp, wings crumpling, then recovers

die.action: shrieks, swells with orange light shining through the cracks in its skin, and pops like a firecracker into a puff of black soot and embers
